name: Unripe Green Bananas (Resistant Starch Bloating Warning)
whyItWorks: Unlike sweet ripe yellow bananas, unripe greenish bananas are packed with type 2 resistant starch. Resistant starch resists small bowel digestion entirely and ferments rapidly in the colon, producing massive gas, abdominal distension, and severe colonic pain.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Never eat bananas with green skins or green necks during flares. Let them sit on the counter until fully golden yellow with light brown freckles.
watchOuts: Massive resistant starch load causes rapid microbial fermentation, severe bloat, and gas pressure against inflamed bowel walls.
